name: keelcard.cards.list
description: List cards on this account. Closed cards stay hidden unless include_closed is true. Full numbers stay off this result.

name: keelcard.cards.get
description: Read one masked card.

name: keelcard.controls.get
description: Read limits, blocks, alerts and the verification mode. Codes are not included.

name: keelcard.controls.requests.list
description: List change requests without verification codes.

name: keelcard.transactions.list
description: List authorizations with effective status. Expired holds drop out of the effective status before settlement.

name: keelcard.transactions.get
description: Read one authorization.

name: keelcard.declines.list
description: List committed declines. A decline does not change limits, holds or balance.

name: keelcard.spend.summary
description: Spent amounts against each limit for the current day, month and lifetime.

name: keelcard.authorizations.lookup
description: Read the decision for an authorization key. Unknown keys return a null authorization and no card details.

name: keelcard.statements.list
description: List issued monthly statements.

name: keelcard.cards.create
description: Create a card at or under the owner ceiling. The full number is stored and a masked result is returned.

name: keelcard.cards.update
description: Change a card nickname.

name: keelcard.cards.pause
description: Pause an active card. The delegate can unpause this directly.

name: keelcard.cards.unpause
description: Unpause a card this delegate paused. An owner pause needs a change request.

name: keelcard.cards.close
description: Close a card. Closing is irreversible.

name: keelcard.cards.reveal
description: Record a disclosure and return the full number, expiry and security code when the delegate is allowed to reveal.

name: keelcard.controls.lower
description: Lower one limit immediately.

name: keelcard.controls.block
description: Block a merchant or a category immediately.

name: keelcard.controls.request_change
description: Open a step-up request to raise a limit, remove a block, or unpause an owner-paused card. The code stays off this result.

name: keelcard.controls.confirm_change
description: Confirm an email-code request. Wrong codes, exhausted attempts and expiry commit. Owner-approval mode rejects the call.

name: keelcard.controls.cancel_request
description: Cancel an open change request. A request that is already due settles to expired instead.

name: keelcard.disputes.list
description: List disputes on this account.

name: keelcard.funding.get
description: Read the local funding balance and the amount still available after open holds.

name: keelcard.statements.get
description: Read one issued statement.

name: keelcard.alerts.preferences.get
description: Read alert preferences. Codes are not included.

name: keelcard.merchants.block
description: Block a merchant on this account immediately.

name: keelcard.merchants.unblock
description: Ask to remove a merchant block. A delegate request waits for verification.

name: keelcard.disputes.open
description: Open a dispute on a captured charge inside the 120-day window.

name: keelcard.disputes.withdraw
description: Withdraw a dispute that is still submitted.

name: keelcard.alerts.preferences.update
description: Add an alert or lower a decline threshold immediately. Turning an alert off or raising the threshold opens a change request.
